title: The cheapest flight I can get a refund on
description: The cheapest fares on the route are Puffin Air, which never refunds. The agent has to read the fare rules, not just sort by price.
task: I need to get from Aira to Zahrun this Friday, 8 March. Book me the cheapest flight I could still get a refund on if my plans change. Passenger: Rin Kade, email rin@example.com. Tell me the booking reference when it's done.

checks.description: Aira to Zahrun on Friday 8 March, for Rin Kade
Not on Puffin Air, whose fares are non-refundable
The cheapest refundable fare (211 bucks on Maya Air)
Every reference it quotes is real
